memories.content: The chair is stepping down and has not yet identified a successor. They want the society to continue smoothly and hope someone will volunteer.

The Kettlewell Allotment Society holds an annual general meeting in five weeks, at which nominations for chair close. The current chair has announced they are stepping down. Any member may volunteer to stand for chair before the meeting.
